boundary_items: IP.PR.03.002 — Cart UI with quantity stepper + veg indicators
IP.PR.03.015 — Fee/tax breakdown visible in cart/checkout

file_reviews_and_fixes.pre_patch_issue: Non-guest storage key, no schema version/updatedAt, 10% tax, no platform fee, silent cross-restaurant clearing with stale-items bug.
file_reviews_and_fixes.fix: Versioned bhojango-cart-guest persistence, updatedAt, 5% GST, 2% platform fee, delivery-fee helper, conflict detection, replaceCartWithItem.

file_reviews_and_fixes.pre_patch_issue: Missing platform/discount/grand-total fee lines, user-country currency fallback, incomplete dark mode.
file_reviews_and_fixes.fix: Full fee breakdown, cart currency, veg/non-veg labels, dark-mode classes, accessible quantity controls.

file_reviews_and_fixes.pre_patch_issue: Add-to-cart directly mutated store; no cross-restaurant Cancel/Start New Cart guard.
file_reviews_and_fixes.fix: Conflict detection before mutation and modal with Cancel / Start New Cart actions.

file_reviews_and_fixes.pre_patch_issue: Logout did not clear persisted guest cart.

file_reviews_and_fixes.fix: Checkout summary now shows Items Total, Delivery Fee, Platform Fee, Tax/GST, Discount, Grand Total from cart store.

file_reviews_and_fixes.pre_patch_issue: Weak smoke test without SPR-03A acceptance assertions.
file_reviews_and_fixes.fix: Focused Playwright assertions for empty cart, localStorage persistence, fee rows, quantity updates, and cross-restaurant guard.
